summary: Hardin County, TN Aermotor LS-40 tower listed as standing; NHLR-registered in 2023 as US 1757, TN 61 and administered by the Tennessee Division of Forestry. No build date found.

events.note: Listed among the extant towers as of March 26, 2014
NHLR records a site visit dated 1/29/20
Registered August 7, 2023 as US 1757, TN 61; nominated by Jason Johns

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 680 ft (207 m); Tennessee Landforms lists 673 ft. The difference is small and is not used in the story.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, builder, height, staffing, fire history or access statement was found. Standing rests on the Tennessee Landforms table plus a 2020 NHLR site visit; the Register does not say 'standing' in words. The brief's agency field is consistent with the Register's administrator line. Access is left out of facts because nothing was found.
